blocks.text: HYBE said K-pop supergroup BTS is set to continue expanding its global reach in 2027 by working on new music and pursuing group as well as solo projects. The South Korean entertainment company announced this on Tuesday, Nov. 3, while also reporting its record-high third-quarter revenue and operating profit, which they primarily attributed to the success of BTS’ ongoing “Arirang” world tour. “[BTS] plans to work on new music and pursue diverse projects simultaneously to expand its reach,” HYBE said of the group’s plan for the first half of 2027, as per The Korea Herald.
